messages:
rachel: Quick feedback on the Export Presets mini-flow. Goal: reduce cognitive load for users exporting vectors at scale. Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-export-ui
omar: First impression: too many toggles. Suggest grouping 'Format' (CSV/Parquet), 'Payload' (vectors/metadata), and 'Options' (delimiter, include_ids) into three compact sections.
maria: Agree. Also make presets visually distinct from ad-hoc settings. Presets should be cards with a one-line summary: e.g., 'CSV • ids • normalized'. Keep summaries to 3 tokens.
jiho: Accessibility: preset column should be role=listbox and each preset role=option. When applied announce: "Preset 'Compact CSV' applied 1 settings changed" via aria-live polite.
rachel: Preview pane: default to 'Sample (1 row)' with truncated fields and a small 'Show full preview' link. Full preview expands but shows "[vector truncated]" for long vectors.
omar: Interaction: when user modifies a field after applying a preset, show 'Modified' badge and a small 'Revert' action. If they save, open 'Save as preset' modal rather than silently overwrite.
maria: Copy decisions: header = 'Download vectors'; primary CTA = 'Download'; secondary = 'Apply'; overflow = 'Save as preset...'. Row menu: 'Download row (ignores preset)'. Keep labels short.
jiho: Edge-case validation: if preset requires 512-d but dataset is 768-d show inline warning: 'Requires 512-d vectors 1 current dataset is 768-d.' Provide a link to docs: /docs/optimize/quantize.
bot-figma: Prototype uploaded: https://figma.com/file/new-export-ui - version export-presets-2026-03-25.
rachel: Action items: 1) convert presets to cards + summaries (omar) 2) implement role=listbox and aria-live messages (jiho) 3) sample/full preview + truncated vector placeholder (maria) 4) modified badge + revert/save behavior (omar)
